meta.title: dsh-argp
meta.description: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log. 压缩率精确兑现，历史永不销毁。

en.argpDescription: Automatically trims a long conversation to free up room. Changes apply live, no restart.
en.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
en.maxPassesHint: Safety cap on the prune loop; it normally stops at the compression target, when nothing is left to prune, or on a no-progress pass — this only bounds extreme spin
en.recencyGuardHint: Newest N messages are never pruned
en.saveFailed: These values were not accepted; they were left for you to correct.
en.sortModeHint: Density = drop big, low-info spans first (recommended); +chain = repeated versions pruned sooner; In order = legacy
en.turnGuardHint: Last N turns are never pruned
